meta.title: Surrogate bid placed in a Reverse Auction stage
gaps: Attaching a Surrogate Bid Reference during bid submission
Verifying that the Surrogate Bid marker is blue and positioned next to the currency under the vendor's name
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Attaching a Surrogate Bid Reference during bid submission; Verifying that the Surrogate Bid marker is blue and positioned next to the currency under the vendor's name

steps.note: Open the existing event's project details page.
Navigate to the live Reverse Auction stage.
Open the auction stage's Participants section to locate an eligible vendor.
Enter and submit a buyer-entered bid for the participating vendor in the Reverse Auction stage.
Assert that the surrogate bid submission was accepted.
Verify the buyer's auction response view contains one response marked Surrogate Bid.
Open the auction QCS to inspect the vendor bid after submission.
Assert that the QCS visibly identifies the recorded bid as a surrogate bid.
